inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev9 ULTIMATE UFO, dev8 MANDALA, dev7 HORNET propagation, dev6 prism-wall, dev5 full-armor/CRAB, native-format, mod-package and source-only gates remain inherited. Dev10 adds the executable-backed HORNET exposed-core state-3 entry and fresh real-retail validation.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 92/92 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and HORNET exposed-core checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: hornet_exposed_core is the deterministic state-3 entry snapshot; it does not claim A1 remains frozen at sample 0 throughout the entire attack state.
The state-3 exposed-core preset contains A1 visible geometry only; C1 remains a meshless runtime formation rig and BF/C0 pools are not selected after the common reset.
HORNET prism-wall and state-6 propagation catalogs remain runtime families rather than one canonical random result.
Fresh retail Xbox game data was used only for external validation; no proprietary package, GMX, ANM or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
